story.iWant: to automatically extract and transcribe audio from my timeline
story.soThat: I can use it as context for social media post generation
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create audio extraction service (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Task 2: Implement Whisper API integration service (AC: 4, 8) - Task 3: Add IPC handler for transcription (AC: 6) - Task 4: Implement progress tracking and IPC events (AC: 5) - Task 5: Add comprehensive error handling (AC: 7, 8) - Task 6: Implement file size management (AC: 8) - Task 7: Add temporary file cleanup (Best practice) - Task 8: Update aiStore for transcription state (AC: 6) - Task 9: Write unit tests for audio extraction service (Testing) - Task 10: Write unit tests for Whisper service (Testing) - Task 11: Write integration tests for transcription flow (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Main process service extracts audio from all timeline clips (concatenated) 2. Extracted audio converted to format compatible with Whisper API (MP3/WAV) 3. Service validates timeline has audio/video clips before extraction 4. Whisper API integration transcribes audio using `whisper-1` model 5. Progress indicator shows transcription status (percentage if possible) 6. Transcription result returned to renderer process via IPC 7. Error handling for API failures with user-friendly messages 8. Service properly handles large audio files (up to 25MB Whisper limit)

docs.doc: Defines audio-extractor.service.ts for extracting/concatenating audio from timeline clips, and whisper.service.ts for OpenAI Whisper API transcription. Both services operate in Main Process.
Specifies IPC handler ai-transcribe-audio for orchestrating extraction and transcription, with progress events ai-transcription-progress.
Workflow 2: Audio Transcription flow - extract audio from timeline → transcribe via Whisper → return result.
Performance requirements: handle up to 25MB audio files with compression/chunking, emit progress updates every 10%.

story-context.constraints: - Process Separation: Audio extraction and Whisper API calls execute entirely in main process for security and performance - FFmpeg Integration: Reuse existing FFmpeg setup from Epic 1 (ffmpeg-static package bundled with app) - File Size Limits: Whisper API max 25MB. Apply compression (64kbps bitrate) or chunking (10-min segments) if exceeded - Temporary Storage: Save audio files to os.tmpdir()/chop-shop/ai-audio/ with cleanup after processing - Progress Tracking: Emit IPC events during extraction (0-50%) and transcription (50-100%) - Error Handling: Return user-friendly error messages for timeline validation, FFmpeg failures, API errors, rate limits - OpenAI SDK: Use official openai package for Whisper API integration with model whisper-1
story-context.interfaces:
<interface name="IPC: ai-transcribe-audio" kind="ipc-channel" signature="() => Promise<IPCResponse<{text: string; duration: number}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Orchestrates audio extraction from timeline and Whisper transcription. Emits progress events.
Progress event emitted during extraction and transcription with percentage and descriptive message
<interface name="AudioExtractorService.extractAudioFromTimeline" kind="service-method" signature="(clips: TimelineClip[]) => Promise" path="src/main/services/ai/audio-extractor.service.ts"> Extracts and concatenates audio from timeline clips, returns temp audio file path
<interface name="WhisperService.transcribeAudio" kind="service-method" signature="(audioFilePath: string, apiKey: string) => Promise" path="src/main/services/ai/whisper.service.ts"> Transcribes audio file using OpenAI Whisper API, handles file size validation and chunking

tests.standards: Unit tests for services with mocked FFmpeg and OpenAI SDK. Integration tests for IPC flow with mocked services. Use Vitest framework. Test edge cases: empty timeline, large files, API failures. Manual testing with real timeline clips and OpenAI API.
tests.ideas: - AC 1, 2: Test audio extraction with mock timeline clips, verify FFmpeg commands for concatenation and format conversion - AC 3: Test timeline validation (no clips, no audio tracks) returns error - AC 4: Test Whisper API call with mocked OpenAI SDK, verify model=whisper-1 - AC 5: Test progress event emission at key stages (extraction start, extraction complete, transcription complete) - AC 6: Test IPC handler returns transcription text and duration to renderer - AC 7: Test error handling for FFmpeg failures, API auth errors, network errors, rate limits - AC 8: Test file size validation, compression (bitrate reduction), and chunking for large files (>25MB) - Integration: Test full flow (timeline → extract → transcribe → cleanup)
